newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Van Leer has NLG 450 mln ready to invest.
newsitem.headline: Van Leer has NLG 450 mln ready to invest.

text.p: Dutch packager Van Leer said on Monday it had a war chest of some 200-250 million guilders available for acquisitions and had earmarked a further 200 million guilders for investment.
"Van Leer thinks more in terms of acquisitions than greenfield sites, but it is also investing," Van Leer chairman Bill de Vlugt told a results news conference.
Financial controller Dick van den Akker said the firm had earmarked some 200 million guilders for investment, excluding acquisitions.
These included investments in information technology and Van Leer's "factory of the future" project, which is seen virtually doubling efficiency in steel drum manufacturing.
De Vlugt said the project was only applicable in large-scale drum-making operations.
Construction work on the first factory was due to start some time this year to come on line in 1998, he said, but declined to specify the investment involved.
Asked about the new location of the plant De Vlugt said "I can't tell you right now -- possibly Britain."
Van Leer is also starting a greenfield operation for the production of steel drums in Japan.
De Vlugt said acquisitions would concentrate mainly on consumer packaging, focusing on South America and the Far East.
"Here and there we have some irons in the fire," he said.
But he added takeover prices were fairly high and the company was not being hurried into any deals.
